description: This file defines a TransactionsProvider class in Dart, which is a ChangeNotifier that manages a cache of TransactionModel objects, providing methods to load recent transactions, add, update, and remove transactions, interfacing with a TransactionRepository.

classes.name: TransactionsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of TransactionModel objects, providing methods for fetching and manipulating transaction data with in-memory caching.

methods.name: loadRecent
methods.description: Loads recent transactions from the repository with an optional limit. Updates internal cache and notifies listeners.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new transaction to the repository and inserts it at the beginning of the local cache, notifying listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction in the repository and updates it in the local cache if found, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the repository and the local cache based on ID, then notifies listeners.
